_doc.blocksize: Default block size when no override/adaptive match applies
_doc.colorprofile: cs for sRGB, cl for linear
_doc.min_size: Minimum width/height in pixels. Sprites smaller than this are excluded (default: 500)
_doc.max_size: Maximum width/height in pixels. Sprites larger than this in EITHER dimension are excluded (0 = no limit)
_doc.overrides: Map of filename substrings to ASTC block size overrides
_doc.exclusions: List of filename substrings. Matching files are NEVER converted
